summary: San Francisco Bay Area, open source software advocate, strong proponent of privacy and anti-DRM, critical of corporate monopolies (especially Apple and Microsoft), interest in decentralized social networks (Diaspora*), technical background in software development, expertise in web standards and browser technologies, active in discussions about software patents and their impact on innovation, supporter of Mozilla and Firefox, engaged in mobile Linux projects (Mer and Nemo Mobile), critical of vendor lock-in practices, interest in philosophy and ethics in technology.
